concepts.name: Textlet
concepts.description: An extremely simple warm ivory loose note sheet, upright and slightly taller than wide, centered on a deep warm charcoal tile (#272822). A substantial top-right folded corner in muted golden amber (#E6B450) is the identifying feature. Just two short thick charcoal writing strokes on the lower half of the note, with intentionally unequal lengths. The page is soft ivory (#F1F0E8), not a notebook. Refined Monokai-inspired charcoal, ivory, and amber contrast. Calm, lightweight, practical. The page must remain the dominant silhouette, not a pencil.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original macOS application icon concept for a very lightweight plain-text notes editor. The direction is quiet, friendly stationery, not a coding IDE. Produce ONE polished square icon only, front-facing and centered. A macOS rounded-square outer tile fills about 86% of the square canvas, with generous clear silhouette. Materials are matte with a very subtle tactile paper relief and restrained shadows; clean, crisp edges and large simple shapes, recognizable at 32px. Sparse interior, no busy details, no photography, no screen mockup, no surrounding objects, no gradients that resemble glass, no glow. Absolutely no text, letters, wordmarks, numbers, watermarks or coding symbols. The area outside the rounded-square tile must be genuinely transparent. This is an exploratory icon, not a copy of any existing app logo.
Concept identity (not printed): Textlet.

concepts.name: 折页 Foldnote
concepts.description: A single sculptural ivory paper sheet whose lower-right quarter is folded diagonally upward, creating a bold triangular sage-green underside. The fold is large and structural, like a bookmark corner, not a tiny dog-ear. Upright sheet with a gently rounded top, on a muted sage-green rounded-square tile (#718875). One discreet embossed short line only on the paper; no pencil. Very simple geometry with clear negative space. Soft ivory (#F7F4E8), sage and a slightly deeper green fold shadow. Tactile but restrained, sophisticated stationery.

concepts.name: 拾记 Jotly
concepts.description: Two small warm ivory memo slips overlapping. Back slip tilted a few degrees left, front slip upright and offset slightly right, with a single thick muted terracotta horizontal ink stroke. A tiny restrained terracotta corner tab belongs to the front slip. The two slips together form a single strong balanced mark, not a pile or notebook. A warm clay/terracotta rounded-square outer tile (#BB7960), ivory (#FFF4E1) paper, subtle warm shadows. Friendly and warm, representing picking up fragments of ideas. No pen or checklist marks.

concepts.name: 点记 Dotnote
concepts.description: An ivory rounded-square outer tile (#F2F0E8). In its center sits a slightly inset white rectangular note sheet, identifiable by a very subtle relief edge. The sheet carries ONE large dusty blue ink dot at upper-left of its inner writing area, and two confidently thick short dusty blue horizontal writing strokes to the right/below it, composed as a balanced minimal notation. One tiny bottom-right fold, low relief. The ink dot and two strokes form the primary recognizable silhouette, do not look like a face or a letter. Dusty deep blue (#55788D) with warm ivory, generous empty space. Exceptionally simple, quiet, approachable.
